notes: Photo colour values are observed material approximations, not spectrophotometer measurements. Photograph dates are not supplied by the venue.
Satellite colour is sampled only inside mapped roof footprints on a 10 m grid; a tessellated interior point is used for roofs smaller than a source pixel.
Photographic brightness is reduced before it becomes surface albedo to avoid applying sunlight twice. Small-roof colours and facades without photographs remain estimated.
The Welcome Centre exterior roofs appear reddish in the pinned 2026 Sentinel image; the official indoor photograph supports only the light facade and canopy underside.
K1 uses the main-stand material family checked against its light roof in Sentinel; its promotional photo does not independently establish the top-of-roof paint colour.
